summary: Updates the RELATED-TO property of iCalendar (RFC 5545) with new relation types and adds the LINK, CONCEPT, and REFID properties. Together these let calendar items be linked to each other and to related data, and be grouped more flexibly. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Calendar events usually sit alone. This adds sticky notes saying this event goes with that one, or links to files, so related events can be tied together.

questions: how to link icalendar events together
